t: Din hepshet umeliga umelicha beyom tob
s: Din hepshet umeliga umelicha beyom tob ubo y"g seipim: en margilin beyom tob. Ketzad hu hammargil? Zeh hammapshit et haor meragleha kelappe roshah umotzi kol haor shel haggup shalem kede laasot mimmennu nod, shennimtza shettoreach beyom tob shello letzorek hayyom. Veyesh omerim deeno asur ella lehotzi kol habbasar meregel echad kede sheyyotzi kol haor shalem beli shum qera, shettoreach behepshet zo torach gadol shello letzorek yom tob. Veyesh lehachamir kisbara harishona.

Asur limlog kol habbehema kede lehapshitah al yede kak, mippene sheqqal yoter lehapshit millimlog. Vaapillu limlog haggedi kede leoklo beoro — asur, mippene shennireh yoter kemaaseh chol bimliga mibbehepshet. Abal op shei epshar lehapshito — muttar lemolgo ulehabheb kol gupo. Veken muttar limlog harosh veraglayim apillu shel behema, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"q.

Behema shennishchata beyom tob — muttar letaltel orah mechamma letzel ap al pi sheen aleha basar. Umuttar littenah bimqom derisat haraglayim shello yippased haor, sheim lo nattir lo yimmana millishchot, venimtza memaet besimchat yom tob. Abal asur lehagbiah haor leshotchah al gabbe yetedot, mippene shennikkar haddabar sheeno oseh ella letzorek haor, veim nattir lo zeh — yattir leatzmo laasot gem ken shear tzorke haor, dehaynu melicha veibbud, velo hittiru ella littenah bimqom derisat haraglayim, sheen nikkar shehittiru lo mishshum tzorek haor bilbad, ella mippene sherauy lesheb aleha.

Veen molechin al gabbe haor basar liqdera. Apillu im hu munnach beshippua sheen bo issur mishshum moleach al gabbe keli sheeno menuqqab — ap al pi ken asur, mippene shetztzarik lemolcho heteb, venimtza meabbed et haor. Abal muttar limloach alayv basar melicha qalla kederek shemmolechin letzali sheyyitten hammelach taam bo, dehatztzali en tzarik melicha, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman a"v. Umuttar lehaarim velimloach kan basar meat vekan basar meat ad sheyyimlach et kullah.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennishchata beyom tob, sheim lo yattiru lo laasot ken yimmana millishchot. Abal im nishchata beereb yom tob, apillu hupsheta beyom tob — asur letaltel et haor velitteno bimqom derisat haraglayim. Veken asur limloach alayv basar apillu melicha qalla, deap im neesor lo lo yimmana millishchot beereb yom tob, dahare yakol lehapshitah velaasot kol tzorke haor beereb yom tob. Abal im nishchata samuk lachasheka, shello haya shahut lehapshitah qodem yom tob — muttar letaltel haor mechamma letzel, velitteno bimqom derisat haraglayim, velimloach alayv melicha qalla, kede shello yippased haor. Abal im yodea bevadday shello yippased haor — asur apillu letaltelo mechamma letzel, vaapillu nishchata beyom tob.

Baggaluyyot sheosim shene yamim tobim missapeq — hare yom tob rishon nechshab lechol legabbe yom tob sheni, lepikak im nishchata beyom tob rishon — dinah keillu nishchata beereb yom tob leinyan tiltul haor umelichato.
Notzot shel op hen muqtzim, shehare enan reuyim liklum, ulepikak en letaltelam beyom tob, ella im ken nishchat haop beyom tob, deaz hittiru letaltelan lehatznian kede shello yimmana millishchot.

Or shehupshat meereb yom tob — dino kemo beshabbat, sheim hu lach — asur letaltelo, lepi sheeno rauy lishiba, veim hu yabesh — muttar letaltelo, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"[ch]. Abal im hupshat beyom tob, im hu lach — muttar letaltelo mechamma letzel kede shello yasriach, kemo shennitbaer. Veim hu yabesh, ledibre haoserim nolad beyom tob — asur letaltelo, deetmol haya tapel labbehema venechshab kabbehema atzmah veakshav hu keli bipne atzmo, vahare zeh nolad, ukebar nitbaer besimman ttz"h deyesh lehachamir benolad atzmo.

Ap al pi sheen ibbud baokalin kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"a, mikkol maqom dabar sheeno okel gamur, kegon chalabim — hammolechan chayyab mishshum meabbed. Lepikak en molechin et hachalabim beyom tob, apillu nishchata habbehema beyom tob, shehare hem asurim baakila, venimtza oseh melaka shello letzorek yom tob. Veasur limloach alehem basar baavir beinyan sheeno nogea bahem, kede sheyyippol hammelach gam alehem. Vaapillu melicha qalla asur limloach alehem, mishshum dachalabim day lahem bimlicha muetet, venimtza dahare hu kimabbed.

Veken en mehappekin et hachalabim, veen shotechin otan baavir al gabbe yetedot, kede shello yasrichu, apillu nishchata habbehema beyom tob. Veen mattirin lo kede shello yimmana millishchot, lepi shehaddabar nikkar sheoseh ken letzorek hachalabim, veim nattir lo laasot ken — ap hu yattir leatzmo laasot shear tzorke hachalabim, dehaynu lemolchan. Abal muttar letaltelan mechamma letzel kede shello yasrichu, o lehatznian bishbil shello yobdu, sheim lo nattir lo yimmana velo yishchot kelal, vekevan sheen mattirim lo ella tiltul beolma, veen mattirin lo leshotchan baavir — en chosheshim shemma yattir leatzmo ap melichatan. Abal im hen munnachim betzel bemaqom hammishtammer — asur letaltelan ledibre haoserim nolad beyom tob, shehare etmol hayu mechubbarim utepelim legabbe habbehema venechshabim kabbehema atzmah veakshav enan reuyim veomedim ella lehadlaqa, vahare zeh nolad.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennishchata beyom tob, abal im nishchata meereb yom tob — muttar letaltel hachalabim beyom tob im lo hiqtza otam lischora, shehare meetmol hen omedim lehadlaqa, veen kan nolad kelal. Veken chatikat shaava sheyyukal lehanniach petila al gabbah — muttar letaltelah beyom tob, ella im ken hiqtza otah lischora, shehare hi reuya lehadlaqa. Umikkol maqom, nakon lizzaher shello letaltelan ki im letzorek harbeh, kegon shemmityare shello yigganebu vekayyotze bazeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"b gabbe tiltul etzim yebeshim, ayyen sham.

Eli, shehu dap ab vekabed, ukeli hu, ella shemmelakto leissur, liktosh bo haripot — muttar letaltelo letzorek meqomo o letzorek gupo, kegon leqatztzeb alayv basar. Uleachar sheqqitztzeb alayv basar — asur letaltelo shello letzorek gupo o meqomo, kedin keli shemmelakto leissur, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch.

Ap al pi shebbeshabbat asur letaltel kol keli shehu muqtzeh mechamat chesron kis shemmaqpid alayv millehishtammesh bo tashmish acher, mikkol maqom beyom tob muttar letaltelo letzorek simchat yom tob, kegon leqatztzeb alayv basar vekayyotze bazeh, ayyen simman tq"t.
